`final class ObjFace`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.obj.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ObjFace.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/obj/data/ObjFace.java)

One triangle of an ObjModel, with its vertices, its optional texture coordinates and normals, and the normal of its plane.

- [3D models](/use/learn/going-further/3d-models/)

## Creation details

<a id="ObjFace-factory-of"></a>

### of

`ObjFace of(ObjVertex[] vertices, ObjTextureCoordinate[] textureCoordinates, ObjVertex[] vertexNormals)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: An ObjFace has 3 vertices, got …: split the polygon into triangles (ObjModel does it for OBJ files)
- `IllegalArgumentException`: An ObjFace has 3 texture coordinates or none, got …
- `IllegalArgumentException`: An ObjFace has 3 vertex normals or none, got …

Creates a triangle from 3 vertices, and 3 texture coordinates and 3 normals or `null` for none; an empty array of texture coordinates also means none.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` for any other count.
The normal of the plane is computed at once; a degenerate triangle gets `(0, 0, 1)`.

## Method details

<a id="ObjFace-method-render"></a>

### render

`void render(Tessellator tessellator)` 

Adds the triangle to `tessellator`, which must be started in [`DrawMode.TRIANGLES`](/reference/drawing/drawmode/#DrawMode-value-TRIANGLES): with its vertex normals when it has some, otherwise with the normal of its plane.
Texture coordinates move by 0.0005 toward the middle of the triangle, so that a texture atlas does not bleed at the edges.

<a id="ObjFace-method-getVertices"></a>

### getVertices

`ObjVertex[] getVertices()` 

Returns a copy of the 3 vertices.

<a id="ObjFace-method-getVertexNormals"></a>

### getVertexNormals

`ObjVertex[] getVertexNormals()` 

Returns a copy of the 3 normals, or `null` when the face has none.

<a id="ObjFace-method-getTextureCoordinates"></a>

### getTextureCoordinates

`ObjTextureCoordinate[] getTextureCoordinates()` 

Returns a copy of the 3 texture coordinates, or `null` when the face has none.

<a id="ObjFace-method-getFaceNormal"></a>

### getFaceNormal

`ObjVertex getFaceNormal()` 

Returns the unit normal of the plane of the triangle, from the winding of its vertices.
